_comment: Example per-panel parameter overrides for gap_heatmap_movie.py.  Each top-level key is one of {sim, flow, closed, rtonly, plain} (aliases p1_sim, p2_flow, p3_closed, p4_rt, p5_plain also accepted).  Anything not specified inherits from the CLI base flags (--lam0 --mu0 --x --y).  Use this to set per-panel parameters to the ML fits of the respective models.
